title: WEN 944 7-Amp Angle Grinder, 4-1/2", Grey,black,orange
description:

reviews_5s:
I bought this for my night welding class, and it is a very tough grinder, it is holding up very well and fits perfectly in my hand. Does the job that the bigger name brand grinders can do and does not bog down or loos power on anything I grind.I bought this angle grinder for some home improvement projects. I needed something that could handle cutting and grinding various metals without breaking the bank, and this one seemed to fit the bill. It's been working well so far; it can definitely cut through metal like a hot knife through butter. The motor is pretty powerful too, which makes it easy to use even on tougher materials. I managed to modify my old metal table with ease using this grinder (though I did burn a hole in my pants leg during the process - gotta watch out for those sparks!). Overall, I'd say it's a good tool for anyone who needs something reliable and affordable for DIY projects or even professional use.

This angle grinder comes with three grinding wheels and a carrying case, which is nice. The reversible handle is useful too; sometimes you need to change the way you're holding it depending on what you're working on. It's also fairly lightweight compared to some other grinders I've used, so that's a plus. I don't have much else to say about it really. It does its job well and I haven't had any problems with it yet.Honestly I think this is the best corded angle grinder on the market overall! I’ve used plenty of other people’s grinders at work and mine is by far the smoothest and lightest. Overall super impressed by this tool.Works great. I'm using it to grind down stumps among other things. Better disc removal tool than my last grinder.goodGreat product use it daily doesn't over heat light easy to useThis is one good grinder for metal, it goes like crazy !!!!!!!!! It comes with a handle and a good grinding disk. It also comes with the wrench to remove and replace the disk. Very powerful motor too !!!!!!!!!!!I am thoroughly impressed with the WEN 94475 7.5-Amp 4-1/2-Inch Angle Grinder. This tool has quickly become indispensable in my workshop for its exceptional performance and versatility.

Firstly, the 7.5-Amp motor provides ample power for a wide range of grinding and cutting tasks. Whether I'm working with metal, stone, or other materials, the grinder handles each job effortlessly, delivering smooth and precise results.

The reversible handle is a thoughtful feature that enhances comfort and control during operation. It allows me to adjust the grip according to the task at hand, reducing fatigue and improving accuracy.

The inclusion of three grinding discs and a carrying case adds tremendous value to the package. The discs are durable and perform exceptionally well, while the case keeps everything organized and portable, making it easy to transport the grinder to different job sites or store it neatly in my workshop.

Build quality is another highlight of the WEN 94475. It feels solid and well-made, ensuring durability even with frequent use. The ergonomic design further enhances usability, making it comfortable to handle over extended periods.

Overall, I couldn't be happier with my purchase of the WEN 94475 Angle Grinder. It's a high-quality tool that delivers on both performance and convenience, making it a must-have for any DIY enthusiast or professional tradesperson. I highly recommend it without hesitation.This really is a 7 Amp grinder- it is very strong and runs smoothly. I have 3 other grinders and I needed one more to make sure I have no need to change discs...I run a wire wheel, a grinding disc, a flap disc and now this WEN will be the cutoff wheel grinder because it's simply the strongest and the cutoff wheel cuts like butter on this grinder.Don't let the price or the name of the company that makes this tool fool you. This is my 2nd purchase of a Wen power tool and this grinder is powerful and well made. With the proper accessories for grinding or cutting this tool dispels the notion that you need to purchase a more familiar name brand or spend more money, because Wen makes excellent tools at affordable prices.
reviews_1s:
I use this about five times and it worked pretty well those five times. The sixth time I used it the switch popped out and I never could find it. The switch was finicky to begin with, but now it’s gone so the tool is useless.This has to be the worst tool I ever purchased. The safety really works. After you install the grinding disk, the safety shield binds the disk so it will not turn at. With the safety device you'll never get hurt by the spinning disk. Only because it can't turn. First time I tried to used it it jammed up and let the smoke out. The sure fire test to see if your new electric tool is made in China. Try to use it, if it burst into flames, or just looks like it had a smoke bomb stashed inside as it let's the smoke out. If it's brand new and put together correctly and instantly grinds into its self. You have a tool made in China. Foolish me I was starting to think out of the crap companies this wenn might be alright. That's $20.00 plus bucks I'll never get back.Worked great, until the power switch failed—ON! If you jiggle it enough, it will turn off. But guess what? When you go to plug it in again, it might be ON! Fortunately, once it violently runs across your floor, killing everything in its path, it will likely unplug itself so you can clean off the blood and throw it away.UPDATE:
After 6 weeks of use the product has died completely, and the manufacturer wants me to pay shipping for warranty service. Not worth it. Don't buy this.

I have encountered a number of issues with this tool.
1) The screw for the blade guard was EXTREMELY soft and stripped out the first time I tried to adjust it. Now I'm stuck with the guard in one position.
2) I'm running into a stop condition (I suspect overheating) after just 4-5 minutes of use. After allowing cooldown it will run again
3) It was advertised as accepting either 5/8 or 7/8 arbor accessories but I don't see a way to use 5/8 and the manual doesn't mention it.
Overall I guess it might fit the need if you have a small, basic job but disappointing product from Wen.I knew it was cheap but within about a half hour of using it I felt and heard something out of balance with it, I decided to stop. I didn't realize it only has one speed and the switch is pretty sketchy, it flips on full speed and it's got a very cheap switch that stays on, you have to push it in and move it down to turn it off. It should just have a simple pressure grip switch. Anyway, it's dangerous, just pay more for a better one, I was only using it for one thing but it couldn't even do that.Bought this grinder as a back up for my finance last year November. He finally use it late October - early November and after about 15 minutes of use, it start smoking and that's it. No longer workingHere is why is low rating!..the information lists "Arbor adapter allows grinding wheels with both 5/8 and 7/8-inch arbors". There is no adapter for 5/8! THERE IS NONE!. The "threaded" pole is itself 5/8, thus there is no adapter. I called the co. It is a hack! What you do is to take the guard out, then place the 5/8 DIRECTLY on the threaded "pole", flip the first adapter. This leaves the blade exposed (danger!) and rests in a "groove" within the threads! If you do that and avoid danger, you will not be able to get the blade out because it will "set" within the grooves and not come out!. You will have to break it to get it out again!..so...this is a misrepresentation. Otherwise it works so far! disappointed though! VERY!Was grinding away at a 4 inch long weld to try and redo, and it overheated and melted the brushes on the very first wheel. Might handle cutting blades, but this tool cannot be used as a grinder at all. I also ordered new carbon brushes to repair the tool, but the company sent me sure filters with the wrong product number, then has not replied to me support request in over a week. I'm out the money for the grinder and another $16 for me brushes that the company has not mailed or responded. I'm likely going to have to go to my bank and advise Wen of fraudulently charging me to get my money back, yay! Don't buy WEN products. Product was cheap, support and service are even worse.Tried to use it to cut some steel pipe, got half way through the first cut and poof, the motor started smoking and the grinder cut out. I unplugged it and finished the job with my old Dewalt grinder. After I was finished, I checked the Wen grinder, but it will only come on for a moment and then gets hot and shuts off. Luckily these things are pretty cheap, so it is not the end of the world, but I doubt I will be buying any more stuff from Wen.I started to be a Wen fan until I bought this 4 1/2" grinder. At first, I didn't like the switch to power on the grinder. Seems tricky to use, gotta get it in the right spot to get the switch to move right. Then after changing out disc a couple times, the spindle button stopped working. So I can't change out disc, the grinder is pretty much useless now. You would think there would be a slinder wrench provided for back up for changing out disc. It is just past the 30 day return policy now.
